They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice✨🌶️🍗 #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickdinner #weeknightmeals #onepanmeal  Recipe: * 6–8 boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Avocado oil * Cajun seasoning * Paprika * Onion powder * 1 packet sazon * Garlic powder * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tbsp butter * 1 diced onion * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 red bell pepper, diced * 1 orange bell pepper, diced * Cooked white rice * Fresh parsley, for topping Creamy Cajun Garlic Sauce * 2 tbsp butter * 2–3 cloves garlic, minced * Paprika, to taste * Cajun seasoning, to taste *Italian seasoning  * 1 cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Season the chicken:     Add the chicken thighs to a large bowl. Drizzle with avocado oil and season with Cajun seasoning, paprika, sazon, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Cook the chicken:     Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a little avocado oil or butter. Sear the chicken thighs on both sides until golden brown and cooked through, reaching an internal temperature of 165°F. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside. 3. Cook the vegetables:     In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon of butter. Add the diced onion and minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add the diced red and orange bell peppers and cook for a few minutes until softened. Season with a little more Cajun seasoning. 4. Add the rice:     Once the vegetables are softened and slightly browned, add your cooked white rice to the pan. Mix everything together well so the rice is coated with all those Cajun flavors. 5. Add the chicken:     Place the cooked chicken thighs on top of the rice and vegetables. 6. Make the creamy Cajun sauce:     In a small saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. Add paprika and Cajun seasoning, italian seasoning and stir to combine. Pour in 1 cup of heavy cream and bring it to a gentle simmer. Continue stirring until the sauce begins to thicken. 7. Bring it all together:     Pour the creamy Cajun garlic sauce over the chicken and rice. Garnish with fresh parsley. 🌿

Un ambiente de absoluta incredulidad y tensión se vivió en el reconocido parque Yorkshire Wildlife Park, ubicado en Inglaterra, tras la difusión de unas imágenes que rápidamente encendieron las alarmas en redes sociales.   Lo que parecía ser una jornada tranquila dentro del recinto salvaje dio un giro perturbador cuando visitantes captaron el momento exacto en que un imponente tigre siberiano recorría los prados del parque. Sin embargo, no se trataba de un paseo rutinario: el felino avanzaba firmemente sosteniendo en su hocico lo que muchos espectadores afirmaron, en medio del pánico y el drama, que era la cabeza de un hombre devorado tras un trágico incidente.   El video se propagó como pólvora en cuestión de minutos, desatando una ola de teorías, angustia y debate internacional. Mientras la angustia crecía entre quienes observaban las escalofriantes tomas, miles de usuarios en plataformas digitales exigían respuestas inmediatas sobre las medidas de seguridad del lugar. Pese a que las versiones iniciales y el pánico sugerían la peor de las tragedias, las autoridades e informes del parque aclararon que las imágenes correspondían a la hora de alimentación habitual del felino (feeding time), donde se le administraba su ración de carne. Aun así, la crudeza visual del momento dejó una huella imborrable y un debate abierto sobre lo impactante que puede ser la naturaleza salvaje a los ojos del mundo. ⁠#NoticiasDeImpacto #Inglaterra #YorkshireWildlifePark #Misterio #Tigre   ⁠

A massive debris-laden flash flood struck the Budhi Gandaki River in Gorkha's Chumnubri Rural Municipality after a landslide blocked the river flow. Viral footage captured the shocking moment a giant boulder rolled relentlessly down the grey torrent, highlighting the severe destruction caused by the sudden surge. The flash flood swept away more than 35 houses, several bridges, and local infrastructure across riverside settlements like Jagat and surrounding areas. While authorities have reported no human casualties so far, hundreds of residents have been displaced as rescue teams and security forces mobilize to assess the heavy damage. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. I realized I never gave ya’ll the recipe to my BigBrownieChunks or bbc recipe so…here ya go! So gooey!  🍫Pan: 8×8-inch light metal pan Oven: 350°F Ingredients: * 1 cup (226 g) unsalted butter * 1⅓ cups (120 g) Dutch-processed cocoa powder * 1 teaspoon fine sea salt * 2½ cups powdered sugar * ½ cup light brown sugar * 3 large eggs, room temperature * 1 additional egg yolk, room temperature * 3 teaspoons vanilla extract * 1 cup (120 g) all-purpose flour * 1½ cups (280 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips * ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar * Powdered sugar, for finishing Step-by-Step 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8-inch light metal pan with parchment paper. 2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until it becomes golden brown, smells nutty, and you can see browned milk solids at the bottom. 3. Add the cocoa powder and salt to a heat safe bowl. Immediately pour the hot browned butter over the cocoa and whisk or stir until completely smooth and glossy. Let cool until warm, not hot. 4. Whisk the sugars & eggs for that crackle top! In a separate large bowl, combine the powdered sugar, brown sugar, 3 eggs, and additional egg yolk. Whisk HARD for 60–90 seconds, until the mixture looks lighter, thick, glossy, and well combined. 5. Stir the vanilla into the warm cocoa butter mixture. Pour the cocoa mixture into the egg & sugar mixture and whisk until the batter is thick, dark, smooth, and shiny. 6. Gently fold in the flour just until the last dry streak disappears. Do not overmix. 7. Reserve 1/4 cup of batter for extra crackle top! set it aside. 8. Gently fold 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips into the remaining batter. Spread the chocolate-chip brownie batter evenly into the prepared pan. 9. Make the smooth crackle layer Take the reserved ¼ cup of chip-free batter and spread it very thinly over the surface. 10. Sprinkle the ½ cup chopped semi-sweet chocolate bar over the top. These will melt into gooey chocolate pockets. 11. Bake at 350°F for 28–35 minutes. Don’t wait for a completely clean toothpick! the brownies are supposed to stay molten and fudgy inside. 12. Let the brownies cool completely in the pan before lifting them out. #brownies #brownierecipe #molten #chocolate

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Cool for 5 minutes. Mix browned butter with both sugars, then add the egg, extra yolk, and vanilla. Fold in flour, baking soda, and salt, then stir in chocolate . Chill the dough for at least 1 hour. Scoop onto lined baking sheets and bake at 350°F/170C for 10-12 minutes, until golden around the edges but soft in the middle. VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. ENJOY! . . . . #lowcarb #lowcarbrecipes #healthyrecipe #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #whatsonmyplate

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 serving (1 meal prep): Protein: 47g Carbs: 78g Fat: 13g Calories: 616 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 14oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 3 tbsp cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil Honey Soy Glaze - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp minced ginger Korean Cucumber Kimchi Salad - 3 Persian cucumbers, whole, medium - 1/4 tbsp salt - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar - 1/2 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp sesame oil - 1 tbsp gochugaru - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tsp sesame seeds Rice (and topping) - 1.25 cup cooked rice (white or brown) - 2 green onions, medium - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. Mexican Food! Mexican Food! For the meat, boil 2lbs of chicken breast with 3 bay leaves, half an onion, salt, 3 cloves of garlic, and fresh ground pepper! Let them cook until they reach 165 degrees internal temperature. Remove them and let them cool for a bit, then shred them! For the sauce, in the same pot that you boiled your chicken breast, add 2 medium Roma tomatoes, and remove them once the skin breaks. When the chicken is done, transfer the garlic, onion, and tomatoes to your blender! Add 1 tsp of “better than bouillon”, 2 cups of the water you boiled your chicken in, 1 can of chipotle peppers, salt, pepper, and a pinch of oregano. Blend till it's smooth!  In a frying pan add some zero cal cooking spray and half an onion thinly sliced! Once the onion is softened toss in your shredded chicken breast and your sauce. Stir it until the chicken is completely covered in sauce, bring it to a simmer, cover your pan and let it sit off heat for around 10min!  To portion it, weigh out the tinga once it's all cooked and divide that by 5 to get 5 even portions! Mine weighed 48oz so that came out to 5 portions each weighing 9.6oz. For the chips, cut up 4 mission low-carb tortillas into triangles spray them with zero-cal cooking spray and air fry till they are crispy. Usually takes around 3-4min per side at 400 degrees! Ingredients  2lbs chicken breast 3 bay leaves  3cloves of garlic 1 onion 1 can chipotle peppers  Pinch of oregano  2 Roma tomatoes  1tsp “better than bouillon” 4 mission low carb tortillas  Fage 0% greek yogurt  Cotija cheese  Lettuce  Macros for 1 serving of tinga 1oz queso cotija 30g of greek yogurt and 4 low carb tortillas  390 Calories  53g Protein  24g Carbs 9g Fat . #diet #dieta #bajardepeso #weightloss #weightlosstransformation #weightlosscheck #mexican #mexicana #latinos #motivation #healthy #healthyrecipes #healthylifestyle #healthyliving #gym #protein #food #metas #saludable #chicken #mealprep #gym

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Need an easy, incredibly delicious dinner for a busy weeknight? These creamy pan-seared chicken thighs are cozy, comforting, and full of flavor. Juicy chicken thighs, smoky paprika, a rich creamy sauce, and buttery mashed potatoes come together in one satisfying dinner that feels special without being complicated. Perfect for a weeknight dinner, Sunday family meal, or anytime you want something warm, hearty, and homemade. If you are looking for easy chicken dinner ideas, creamy comfort food, or a quick chicken recipe everyone will love, this one might become your new go-to.  Perfect for a weeknight dinner, Sunday family meal, or when you want an easy chicken recipe that feels a little more special. Ingredients: Chicken: • 1½ lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs • 1½ tsp sweet paprika • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ¼ tsp black pepper • Pinch of cayenne, optional • 1 tbsp butter • 1 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar Creamy paprika sauce: • 1 small red onion or 2 shallots • 3 garlic cloves • ⅓ cup (60 g) sun-dried tomatoes, finely chopped • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ¾ cup (180 ml) chicken stock • ¾ cup (180 ml) heavy cream • 1½ tsp Dijon mustard • Small squeeze of lemon juice, optional • Fresh parsley or chives, for serving Potato mash: • 2 lb (900 g) Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks • 4 tbsp (55 g) butter • ½ cup (120 ml) warm heavy cream or whole milk • 1 tbsp sour cream or crème fraîche, optional • Salt, to taste • Black pepper, to taste

Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

Moroccon history edit 🇲🇦☀️ | Song: Baixo Cristal Teclas Morocco, officially the Kingdom of Morocco, is a country located in the northwest corner of Africa. It borders the Atlantic Ocean, the Mediterranean Sea, Algeria, and Western Sahara, making it one of the most strategically located nations on the continent. Its unique position has allowed it to serve as a bridge between Africa, Europe, and the Middle East for thousands of years. Morocco has one of the richest histories in Africa. It was home to the Amazigh (Berber) peoples long before the arrival of Islam in the 7th century. Over the centuries, powerful dynasties such as the Almoravids, Almohads, Saadians, and Alaouites transformed Morocco into one of the strongest states in North Africa. At their height, Moroccan empires ruled territories stretching into modern-day Algeria, Mauritania, Mali, and southern Spain. The country also remained independent from the Ottoman Empire and successfully defended itself against several European invasions. Today, Morocco is known for its diverse landscapes, from the snowy Atlas Mountains to the vast Sahara Desert and its long Atlantic and Mediterranean coastlines. Its cities, including Rabat, Casablanca, Marrakesh, and Fez, are famous for their historic architecture, colorful markets, and rich cultural traditions. Moroccan culture blends Amazigh, Arab, Andalusian, African, and European influences. The country is renowned for its cuisine, traditional craftsmanship, music, and hospitality. Dishes such as tagine and couscous are enjoyed worldwide, while Moroccan mint tea has become a symbol of welcoming guests. In recent decades, Morocco has developed one of Africa's largest economies, with strengths in tourism, agriculture, automotive manufacturing, renewable energy, and phosphate production. The country also gained worldwide recognition when its national football team became the first African nation to reach the FIFA World Cup semifinals in 2022. With over a thousand years of continuous statehood, a rich imperial history, diverse landscapes, and a unique blend of cultures, Morocco remains one of Africa's most influential and historically significant countries. #FYP #Morocco #History #FY #creatorsearchinsights  @🇱🇰✝️ 𝓛𝓪𝓷𝓴𝓪𝓷✝️🇱🇰 (tournament)

Crispy Steak Mac & Cheese 🥩🧀 Ingredients 1 lb cavatappi 16 oz mozzarella 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 4 oz Fontina 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 2 cups heavy cream 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & smoked paprika 1 tsp chicken bouillon ½ tbsp Dijon Reserved pasta water 1 large ribeye or NY strip Salt, pepper & garlic powder 1 tbsp oil + 1 tbsp butter Directions 1. Cook pasta 1 min shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water. 2. Melt 3 tbsp butter, whisk in flour and cook 2 min. Slowly whisk in evaporated milk, then cream, seasonings, bouillon & Dijon. Simmer 3–5 min. 3.Turn heat LOW. Melt in 4 oz each Fontina, mozzarella, Colby Jack & cheddar (16 oz total). Save the remaining 24 oz cheese for layering. 4. Add pasta. If too thick, loosen with reserved pasta water until very creamy. 5. Add half the mac to a baking dish → 8 oz reserved cheese → remaining mac → remaining 16 oz cheese. 6. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25–30 min, then broil 1–3 min until golden and crispy. 7. Season steak and sear in oil about 3–4 min per side. Add butter and baste. For medium-rare, pull around 125–128°F and rest 8–10 min. 8. Rest mac 5–10 min, slice steak and pile it on top.  #macandcheese #comfortfood #easyrecipe #steak #cooking

Claude just dropped Claude Motion, and you can now turn anything into an animated video. Here's how it works: 1. Type /motion, attach your file and tell Claude what you want. Something like "turn this quarterly report into a 30 second explainer for our team meeting". 2. Claude builds an animation out of your text, charts and images, and it plays just like a real video. 3. It's not an AI video model. No fake footage, no AI generated people. Claude builds it all as code, so you can change one word, one number or the timing and everything else stays exactly the same. 4. When you're happy with it, export it as an MP4 or open it in an editing tool like Descript or Runway. It's in beta right now, so not everyone has access yet. videos.caption: Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Save this one for later! 🤎 #BakedChicken #AffordableMeals #DinnerIdeas #ComfortFood #EasyRecipes

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

Grilled Teriyaki Chicken 🔥🍗 Cook Like an Asian Ep 1: Grilled Teriyaki Chicken. Welcome to my series, where I teach you easy Asian recipes so good, your friends will think you’re Asian. 🤙🏽 Sweet, savory, garlicky chicken thighs grilled over charcoal for smoky flavor and a beautiful char. This is the series where I bring the recipes, and you take the credit. 🙌🏽 Ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken thighs ½ cup shoyu (soy sauce) ½ cup brown sugar 5 garlic cloves, crushed 1 tbsp crushed ginger 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp mirin Instructions: 1. Mix the shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and mirin until combined. 2. Reserve ¼ cup of marinade BEFORE adding the raw chicken. Refrigerate separately for brushing during the cook. 3. Place chicken in a zip-top bag and pour in the remaining marinade. Seal, massage to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or overnight. 4. Fire up your charcoal grill. Once the coals are hot, keep one side cooler so you can move the chicken if it browns too quickly.  5. Remove chicken from the bag and discard the used marinade. Grill over the hot coals, flipping and brushing both sides with the reserved marinade to build that beautiful char. 6. Move to the cooler side as needed to prevent burning, and cook until the thickest part reaches 165°F. 7. Rest for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with hot rice! 🍚 Don’t let these ingredients intimidate you because I got all of them from my local Walmart! #teriyakichicken #asianfood #easyrecipe
